bbox_filter: latitude between south and north AND longitude between west and east
wide_query_and_selection: Historical wide filter: ODOR in complaint_type/descriptor/descriptor_2, or sanitation/garbage/dirty categories and URIN substrings. Manufacturing/urinal false matches excluded. Final evidence_group is retained per selected record; five connected street faces nearest the bbox centre were unioned and expanded 12 m. See sites.json, selected_summary.json and site_selection.md. Obsolete process scripts were removed after dependency audit.

global_urination_group.$where: created_date >= '2025-01-01T00:00:00' AND created_date < '2026-01-01T00:00:00' AND complaint_type = 'Urinating in Public'

global_urination_coordinates.$where: same exact category and time filter as global_urination_group

failed_queries: Citywide 2025 grouped ODOR/URIN substring scan timed out after 120 seconds; no citywide absence inference made.
Overpass primary and kumi failed or timed out; private.coffee required a descriptive User-Agent and subsequent bounded requests timed out. No POI counts taken from failed responses.
notes: Current OSM API snapshots are not historical 2025 POI inventories.
No independent urine-odor category confirmed; public urination is a behavior proxy.
Missing coordinate rate cannot be calculated for bbox-filtered local samples.
